bagPolicy.summary: Bearsville Theater hasn't published a bag size policy, but umbrellas aren't allowed inside. Coat hangers are available downstairs at the bottom of the spiral staircase.
bagPolicy.quote: Unfortunately, umbrellas are not permitted inside the venue.

parking.summary: Parking at Bearsville Theater is free and first come, first served.
parking.quote: Parking for Bearsville Theater is free and first-come, first-served.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Bearsville Theater. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Snacks and drinks are sold at the venue, and there's a water fountain inside. Outside food and drinks aren't allowed. Cards are accepted, and there's no ATM.
concessions.quote: Unfortunately, outside food and beverages are not permitted.

accessibility.summary: The building has ADA ramps at the entrance and a ramp to the general admission section, and a chair can be set on the GA floor on request. Certified service animals are welcome with prior approval. Email info@bearsvilletheater.com for ADA requests or service animal approval.
accessibility.quote: The theater has ADA ramps at the entrance to the building, and an ADA ramp to the GA section of the theater.

reEntry.summary: Once you're inside, you can't leave and come back, except to the designated smoking areas.
reEntry.quote: Once inside the venue, you cannot leave and return except for designated smoking areas.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets on Etix or in person at the box office, which opens at 7 PM on show nights. Children under 6 aren't allowed at amplified nighttime shows, and you must be 21 or older to buy alcohol.
ticketPickup.quote: You can also purchase tickets in person at our Box Office which opens at 7PM on show nights.

gates.summary: Use the ADA ramps at the building entrance. Shows are either fully seated or standing general admission, and the open GA floor is first come, first served.
gates.quote: Entrance to the open floor general admission / SRO is on a first-come, first-served basis.
